description: CLI wrapper for Playwright browser automation (npm package @playwright/cli)
notes: All commands are flat. The binary does not use grouped subcommands such as 'browser open' or 'page snapshot'.
The category field mirrors the sections in 'playwright-cli --help'. It is not a command prefix.
On macOS, keep --session/-s names short. The session name is part of a Unix socket path, and long names can cause listen EINVAL.
For secret entry, set PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_SECRETS_FILE when you open the session. Pass the secret key name as the fill text.

Only fill substitutes a secret key. fill maps to the MCP tool browser_type, which calls lookupSecret. NEVER pass a secret key name to type: type maps to browser_press_sequentially, whose handler calls page.keyboard.type(text) with no lookupSecret call, so it types the literal key name into the page and produces a failed login that looks like a wrong-password event. Verified in published @playwright/cli 0.1.18.

MANDATORY after every secret fill: read back per-field value LENGTHS only, never values, and confirm the target field length equals the secret length and no other field length changed. locator.fill() focuses the target in an injected script, then inserts the text out of process with page.keyboard.insertText(), so a page that moves focus receives the secret in a different input while the command still exits 0 and prints the correct locator. Do not submit the form when the check fails. See the 'Secret Fill Verification' principle in SKILL.md.
